title: Stage Stepper UX on Cards/Drawer & Relay Handoff Memory Priming
summary: Implemented tactile pipeline stage stepper/tabs directly on KanbanCard and AgentConsoleDrawer header with 1-click stage switching. Added handover_summary to KanbanTask and wired Zero-Turn Memory Priming in agent.rs so subsequent agents start Turn 1 with full context of previous stage's accomplishments.
